response:
I shall attempt to craft a psalm in the requested style and tone, while adhering to the specified rhyming scheme and consonant cluster requirements.

In fervent fervor, I fervently pray,
That fiery fervor may find its way,
To kindle kindness, and calm the fray,
And bring forth blessings, come what may.

I don't want to set, the world on fire,
With fervent fervor, that may tire,
I just want to start, a flame in your heart,
A gentle glow, that will never depart.

Through trials and tribulations, I'll strive,
To fan the flames, of love and life,
And bring forth fruit, that's ripe and rife,
And in your heart, a spark will thrive.

May fervent fervor, be the guiding light,
That leads you through, the darkest night,
And in the fire, of your heart's desire,
May love and kindness, forever conspire.
